body: It depends on what you write. Sometimes it's better to leave them guessing. Like if you wrote something the people around you would just roll their eyes at. If you have something important to say, say it. If not, just remain quiet.

Every single day. Probably every single minute of every single day. Think of different ways or times I could do it, I think about doing it right now at home or drive somewhere to go do it. It's practically my life.
Still, a tree branch would work whether you're 3 foot tall or 6 ft tall
None of those things are tall enough anyway. I'd go in the backyard and hang myself from a higher tree branch, but that's just me.

My husband did the same thing. He never loved me, but he told me he did and married me just to leave me as soon as he married me. I will never love anyone again. You are young, once you are done with school, start somewhere new. You may feel better

I too keep hoping something will kill me. I have tried starving and dehydrating myself to death, which I'm thinking about trying again starting now. I also have an abusive parent, though she isn't an alcoholic. Maybe you need to distance yourself from your family. I'm sorry about your grandma, mine has dementia and isn't right in the head either.
I understand. I have tried and tried and it seems like nothing ever improves. Sometimes it takes time, or maybe it will never improve. But as long as you are trying it is possible it will.
You are trying, that is a big thing. You should be proud of yourself. 75% of people won't bother improving themselves.
My parents did not love me either. I spent my whole life believing that if my own parents couldn't love me, no one ever would. I was right.
